content: Kukin bwadads teitan bikalouw, ansinap kalbaleb bivag, kadiloka kukidumwa̱lus gamag towen, Kululuwan Yowbad wasigeis yakamiy. Kadiloka kuma̱nums gamag towen beibwein, siwa̱youb waseg. Tage kuvna̱seimiy-vak, mata ge bukukwalouws yakamiy.
Kulabes simsimiyas waseg aveiyag kalbaleb bukulivatus. Kuva̱ges ma̱wan, peinan Kelis nakaleiwags.
Magat teitan ansinap nag, idoki sinap bikaypom kid, singaya ibol nanon tonen; ikatidavina tonen.
Tatanok tatanok yakamiy kadiloka binuway ansinap totonen. Kukin bwein, mo beibwein nanon. Awoum binuway son ansinap. Peinan bitakawes kwanads tatoneids, tatanok tatanok ya̱kids.
Kukin teitan bikatimlakeim sinapun Yeisuw Kelis waseg, kadiloka kusiwyoub taw towen youda babaw bwanabwein waseg.

Awoum teitan bikatidavimiy. Ta-ma̱wan bukubob Yowbad nakaleiwag. Aveiyag bukusop, youd towen mo beisob. Kukin bukusop kaleivim waseg, igaw bukuta̱yoy youd kalbaleb, ipsa̱pwas. Kukin bukusop Yowbad Kululuwan waseg, igaw bukuta̱yoy mumwamov towen bises bisigeg.
Awoum bitasoumats dawotets bwanabwein waseg. Bitavvaluts, nag bikawegweis wouds ee... ta̱yoy anatut mo bitata̱yoys anagin bwanabwein.
Mapun kadiloka bitalabes gamag tababaws-wan, peinan adatuts nises. Singaya bitalabes sidayas tasiyas nisimounids daGuyaws Yeisuw waseg.
Kukines lelel singay avakaein yey nalel namag waseg.

Min-Yudiy nikamliweids peinan adlivans mamagina: “Tasimounid waseg Kelis neiweiys waklos, mo Yowbad bikidumwa̱lud.” Gamag mwasinis isimkineimiy va̱gan bibwabwes momwamiy. Sivines kid youd bwanabwein ankakin watoulan. Kukin bukubwabwes momwamiy, mo beikous sisiyas askameiliw wasigeis tasiyas.
Tage tasiyas nibwabwes momwes nag ivna̱ses min-Yudiy asisinap meivek-wan; nag. Sivines kid bibwabwes momwamiy va̱gan bikaypamweimiy yakamiy.

Yey gog awoum bakaypom. Misinaka bakaypom anklos daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis. Anklos waseg mamagina ven watinow sinapun bo ikanig, mo iyakous nakaleiwag waseg yey; o yey gog waninous ven watinow gimgilis mamagina takanig yey.
Min-Yudiy sikabivatus nag bilabeid; vena babaw asisinap nag bilabeid; misinaka sinap kweivaw, va̱gan bitamlavags gamag kweivaw.
Tayyousins sinap towen yakamiy Yowbad binok nuwan wasigeis yakamiy mo beitaw nuwamiy, simiyas Yowbad inabod kweivaw, mamagina min-Yisleil babaw ya̱kids.
Igaw tut wanakougwaw awoum teitan bivag gunamouvit. Bo misinak! Yeisuw peinan, agupout nises wakaleivig.
Sigweyas yakamiy, daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis bisiwa̱youb kululuwamiy waseg. Eimen. Yey Pawl.
